summary: Site named in a 1954 bid notice for a planned 60-foot steel tower near Spann. No source found confirms a built tower or describes the site today.

facts.design: Planned steel fire lookout tower (60-foot, per a 1954 bid notice)

events.note: Bid notice of September 23, 1954: one of the 60-foot steel towers to be erected near Spann, on a site given by Raymond C. Troxell. The notice does not confirm construction.

notes_for_editor: Thin record. Three sources (the Savage page is used only for the second tower in the same 1954 notice): the 1954 bid notice on the Forest Lookouts page and a Mapcarta entry naming a Spann Lookout Tower in Wayne County. No built date, staffing, agency, status or access found. Two web searches and the FFLOS and NHLR Kentucky lists (neither names Spann Hill) gave nothing more. anyplaceamerica.com returned HTTP 403 and was not read. Record height_m stays null: the 60-foot figure is a bid-notice plan, not a confirmed height. Record agency stays null. Story lede now says 'planned site' (bids opened, towers to be erected) and places Spann Hill in Wayne County from the Forest Lookouts page; Kentucky is attributed to the Mapcarta entry (cite 2), which says 'Wayne, Kentucky'.
